question: In a circle with a radius of 25 cm, a chord with a length of 48 cm is drawn. What is the minimum distance from this chord to another parallel chord of length 40 cm?
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of circle = 25 cm

Length of first chord = 48 cm

Length of second chord = 40 cm

**Formula Used:**

Distance from centre to chord = √(r² − (l ÷ 2)²)

Minimum distance between parallel chords = Difference of their distances from centre

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26bac29e8fa51363f56affe92d4792a25ba4dbf11a929a390ed48b40cc5a20cb.png] 

⇒ Distance₁ = √(25² − 24²)

⇒ Distance₁ = √(625 − 576)

⇒ Distance₁ = √49

⇒ Distance₁ = 7 cm

⇒ Distance₂ = √(25² − 20²)

⇒ Distance₂ = √(625 − 400)

⇒ Distance₂ = √225

⇒ Distance₂ = 15 cm

⇒ Minimum distance = 15 − 7

⇒ Minimum distance = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**
